XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure warning light on with drop in performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | TURBOCHARGER | TURBO | TURBINE | GAINS | LOSES | DROPS | LACKS | POWER | SPEED | DROP | SIGNIFICANT | SIGNIFICANTLY | DRASTIC | DRASTICALLY | WHISTLES | NOISE | STRANGE | WHEN ACCELERATING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Turbocharger

  • Fault: Significant drop in performance, accompanied by a distinct abnormal whistling noise coming from the turbocharger during acceleration.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty turbocharger

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the turbocharger and, if necessary, overhaul or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the turbine was found to have a damaged exhaust ‘spiral’. Following replacement of the turbine, the problem was definitively resolved.
